safetyNotice.title: Chat safely
safetyNotice.description: For your safety, keep your conversations within the Community.
safetyNotice.dialogDescription: Keep your conversations in the Community and avoid sharing passwords, login details, or information that identifies pet owners. When discussing a case, remove identifying details from images and documents before sharing.

history.first: I'm organizing a team discussion about how we review radiographs. Would you share how your team works?
history.second: Of course. I can bring a few fictional examples so we can talk without using patient data.
history.third:
Great. I'd split the discussion in two: how we receive the images and how we record questions that come up during review.

That gives us time to compare how each team works.
history.fourth: Good idea. I'll also write down the questions that tend to come up during shift handoffs.
history.fifth: I found some time on Thursday. If that works for you, I'll send the agenda to the group afterward.
history.sixth: Thursday works. I can prepare a list of the points we want to discuss and bring it to the meeting.
history.seventh: Perfect. Let's leave some time at the end for the rest of the team to add anything.
